rationale: The target requires characterizing whether required braking occurs, so braking response itself legitimately belongs to P. SG-1 and FR-7 establish this behavior, while H-1 supplies the collision-relevant operational context. P remains focused on braking in relevant obstacle encounters; it does not incorporate sensing, computation, communication, or internal control mechanisms merely because they influence braking.
determining_elements: “Vehicle/system braking behavior in obstacle-encounter situations” identifies the behavior required to evaluate omission under SG-1 and FR-7.
“Whether a braking maneuver is initiated when required to avoid collision” directly addresses omission; FR-7.1 also explicitly establishes braking initiation as required behavior.
The scope covers obstacles or road users on or near the trajectory where braking may be required, supported by H-1, FR-7, and FR-7.2.4.
References to obstacle-detection situations define encounter contexts rather than incorporating detection mechanisms or their timing into P.
